messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":11,"verses":[{"chapter":11,"verse":16,"text":"And their father said to them: \"Not only have you here sufficient to live on, but these bring you into a better world to live in, in the heavens."},{"chapter":11,"verse":17,"text":"Or do you not know my children, the value of these things here Hear then! When the Lord had deemed me worthy to have compassion on me and to take off my body the plagues and the worms, He called me and handed to me these three strings."},{"chapter":11,"verse":18,"text":"And He said to me: Rise and gird up thy loins like a man I will demand of thee and declare thou unto me'."},{"chapter":11,"verse":19,"text":"And I took them and girt them around my loins, and immediately did the worms leave my body, and likewise did the plagues, and my whole body took new strength through the Lord, and thus I passed on, as though I had never suffered."},{"chapter":11,"verse":20,"text":"But also in my heart I forgot the pains. Then spoke the Lord unto me in His great power and showed to me all that was and will be."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 16,17,18,19,20 in this chapter.
